title: Voice Activity Detection Turn Taking
motto: Every voice agent lives or dies on two decisions: is the user speaking now, and are they done? VAD answers the first. Turn-detection (VAD + silence-hangover + semantic endpoint model) answers the second. Get either wrong and your assistant either cuts users off or never shuts up.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Every voice agent lives or dies on two decisions: is the user speaking now, and are they done? VAD answers the first. Turn-detection (VAD + silence-hangover + semantic endpoint model) answers the second. Get either wrong and your assistant either cuts users off or never shuts up.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Three distinct decisions a voice agent makes on every 20 ms chunk:

1. **Is this frame speech?** — VAD. Binary, per-frame.
2. **Has the user started a new utterance?** — onset detection.
3. **Has the user finished?** — end-pointing (turn-end).

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: VAD detects speech vs silence for turn-taking in voice agents.

steps.title: Implement vad
steps.body: Implement the function in the workspace. Use hints if stuck — first-try passes earn bonus XP.
